issuer.issuer_score_basis:
f(x)/AladdinDAO maintains documentation, public source/deployments, audits and governance information. Current interface terms remain dated **March5,2026**, describe community contributors, disclaim fiduciary/insured guarantees and restrict interface access in named jurisdictions. These are published positions, not an independent finding that no legal entity or possible remedy can exist. No exact-token corporate dollar repayment obligation, signed financial assurance or independently established holder priority was found in the bounded review.

Token governance, interface terms and live administrative control are different evidence layers. Reputation, protocol revenue and advertised rewards do not establish a guarantee. Institutional signer independence, legal recovery and complete governance/conduct history remain uncertain. The score reflects observable disclosure and functioning public mechanisms alongside those limits.
